claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemMechanics.triggered_reaction
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item is a reaction-gated magic item use keyed off a failed saving throw. The existing magic-item surface only allows passive or proactively activated mechanics, so there is no honest family for a reactive item that opens a response window and spends a charge on commit.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you fail a Dexterity saving throw while wearing the ring, you can take a Reaction to expend 1 charge to succeed on that save instead.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ReactionTrigger.failed_saving_throw
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current trigger grammar covers attack hits, named-spell targeting, and creature-casts-spell. It does not cover reacting to your own failed saving throw, which is the item's explicit trigger condition.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you fail a Dexterity saving throw while wearing the ring

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_substitute
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect is not advantage, a numeric bonus, or a reroll. It replaces an already-failed save outcome with success, which matches the v4 substitute-style roll effect rather than any atom presently surfaced in types.ts.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: expend 1 charge to succeed on that save instead
